headline: Approved issuing an RFP for Veteran's Pool construction and police purchases, including $87,324.00 in vests.
summary: The meeting covered road salt, guardrail costs, a Veteran's Pool construction RFP, and several police purchases. All items were approved unanimously. Police items included ammunition, shields, vests, computer workstations, and uniforms.
decisions: Approved the September 10, 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.
Approved Eastern Salt off of RI State MPA 125 as primary road salt vendor, with Morton Salt as backup, unanimously.
Approved a $25,000.00 increase to contract #26-009 with Reliable Fence for guardrails, paid from the Traffic Bond, unanimously.
Approved issuing an RFP for the construction phase at Veteran's Pool, unanimously.
Approved AAA Police Supply of Dedham, MA as the ammunition supplies awardee for $33,805.00, unanimously.
Approved $13,192.44 purchase of replacement ballistic shields from AAA Police Supply of Dedham, MA, unanimously.
Approved $87,324.00 purchase of replacement ballistic vests from Safariland, through DCF LE Supply, unanimously.
Approved purchase of seven Dell computer workstations from SHI International for $13,274.87, unanimously.
Approved Edward Deutch Uniforms of Providence as the awardee of police RFP #27-005, unanimously.

# CITY OF PAWTUCKET

CITY HALL
137 ROOSEVELT AVENUE
PAWTUCKET, RHODE ISLAND 02860

## OFFICE OF THE PURCHASING DIVISION

DONALD R. GREBIEN, MAYOR

PETER WINGATE, PURCHASING DIRECTOR

Approved by: [handwritten signature]
Date: [unreadable]

## Purchasing Board Meeting Minutes

September 24, 2026

**Present:** Lisa Bessette, Nancy Pelletier, Christopher Brouillette, Mark Wildenhain, Peter Wingate, Purchasing Director

**Absent:** Jeannine Bourski, Acting Finance Director

**Public Input Period:** (none)

**Bid Openings:** 26-023 Oak Hill Park Tennis Courts and Playground Renovations (5 bids)

**Minutes:** September 10, 2026 meeting minutes have been accepted. Lisa Bessette makes a motion to approve. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved

## Communications:

Rick Karsulavitch, DPW, is notifying the board that the department has selected Eastern Salt off of RI State MPA 125 as the primary road salt vendor for the upcoming winter. Morton Salt is elected as the backup in case of delivery issues. All expenses budgeted yearly in General Fund 100. Christopher Brouillette makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.

Joe Morais, DPW, is notifying the Board that, due to concrete and cobblestone found underneath the work site, the contract #26-009 with Reliable Fence of Woburn, MA for Installation of Guardrails along Main 7 Moshassuck Streets had to be adjusted upwards by $25,000.00, to be paid out of the Traffic Bond. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved.

Joe Morais, DPW, is seeking approval to issue an RFP for the construction phase at Veteran's Pool. Eventual contract to be supported by several sources, including CDBG, Recreation & Traffic Bonds, Congressional Direct Spending, RIDEM and Office of Energy Resources. Lisa Bessette makes a motion to approve. Mark Wildenhain seconds. Unanimously approved

Major Dave Holden, Police, is notifying the board that the awardee of the department's informal bid for ammunition supplies will be AAA Police Supply of Dedham, MA. The bid in the amount of $33,805.00 is budgeted through the ammunition/vest budget line item. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved.

Major Dave Holden, Police, is seeking permission to purchase replacement ballistic shields for the Special Response Team through an informal bid. The low bidder of the department's informal bid for shields was AAA Police Supply of Dedham, MA. The shields cost $13,192.44 which is budgeted through the ammunition/vest budget line item. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Christopher Brouillette seconds. Unanimously approved.

Major Dave Holden, Police, is seeking permission to purchase replacement ballistic vests for the Special Response Team. The Police CBA allows them to select any vendor they see fit to supply these items. Safariland, through distributor DCF LE Supply of Auburn, NH has been selected. The vests cost $87,324.00 which is budgeted through the ammunition/vest budget line item. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.

Major Dave Holden, Police, is seeking permission to purchase seven (7) Dell Computer Workstations from SHI International of Somerset, NJ, piggybacking their cooperative NASPO price agreement. Total cost of $13,274.87 is budgeted to the Computer Equipment line. Nancy Pelletier makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.

Major Dave Holden, Police, is notifying the board that the awardee of the department's RFP #27-005 is Edward Deutch Uniforms of Providence All uniform costs are General Fund 100 items as budgeted. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.

Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to adjourn. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved.

Peter Wingate

[handwritten signature]

Purchasing Director
